de.abas.eks.jfop.remote

Class EKSe

  • Object
    • EKSe
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    FOe

    public class EKSe
extends Object
    This class enables complete access to the FO. It uses the English names for the FO commands. It implements
    • all FO commands
    • access to FO variables
    • access to FO expressions
    For the methods which implement the FO commands, the Java method name is generally the same as the name of the respective FO command, whereby lower case letters are being used. Exception: the dot becomes the underscore (e.g. pc_copy() for the FO command PC.COPY).

    All FO methods have a standard string parameter for the parameter transfer to the FO. Its length can at most have the value C.CLIENT_MAXSEND for "multiline" FO commands (box, menu, up, down) and for all other methods at most the value C.FOP_MAXTEXT. If multiline methods are concerned, the individual lines have to be separated by '\n'.

    Options and effects of FO commands are not specified here in more detail since they are identical to the FO. You can read them in the manual in the chapter "FO programming interface".

    FO options and variables have to be specified in english. In the getValue method, the variables language can be specified.

    Example of a call: 

      FOe.system("\"sleep 1\" BACKGROUND");
    This is equivalent to the FO command 
      ..!interpreter english englvar
  .system "sleep 1" BACKGROUND

    Methods which have a success status in the FO (i.e. set the FO variable 'success') have a boolean return value.

    For text output the method println is available.

    The *var method group returns an abas ERP variable of the specified reference object as text Tvar("descr") corresponds to 'T|descr' in the FOP.
